name: AI Tools by Neil Patel

sources.title: Former submit URL now renders Ubersuggest 'Apps & Integrations' page — the standalone AI-tools directory is gone

conditions: The old aitools.neilpatel.com directory appears retired; the live equivalent is Ubersuggest's 'Apps & Integrations' catalog
The only intake found is 'Suggest an Integration' linking to ubersuggest.feedbear.com feature-requests board — a suggestion queue, not a guaranteed listing
requirements: To appear in the Apps & Integrations catalog a product should plausibly integrate with or complement Ubersuggest (SEO/marketing tooling)
Submissions go through a Feedbear feature-request board — community voting likely influences adoption; no published acceptance criteria
preparation: A concrete integration pitch: what the product does and why it belongs in Ubersuggest's apps catalog
Product name, URL, logo, and a short description ready to paste into the Feedbear request
workflow: Open https://aitools.neilpatel.com/ — confirm it now serves Ubersuggest's Apps & Integrations page
Post a feature request describing the product/integration and why Ubersuggest users benefit
Track the request; a listing only materializes if Ubersuggest adds it to the catalog
watchFor: The original submit page no longer exists — the catalog's submissionUrl is stale
Feedbear suggestions are not guaranteed or reviewed on a schedule — this can sit indefinitely
Fit matters: a generic SaaS with no SEO/marketing tie-in is unlikely to be added to an Ubersuggest integrations catalog
No pricing/fee info found because there is no formal listing product
countsAsLive: The product appears as a card on the Ubersuggest Apps & Integrations page (aitools.neilpatel.com / ubersuggest apps catalog) with a link
unknowns: Whether Ubersuggest accepts third-party tool listings at all outside formal partnerships
Review cadence or owner of the Feedbear board
Whether any paid partnership route exists for inclusion
